data.name: Intro
data.value: Every PC in the room shares one 6-digit room code.

data.name: Status_NoCode
data.value: No room code yet. Type the code and save it. Then pair this PC from the console.

data.name: Status_NotPaired
data.value: Not paired yet. On the console, open Set up devices, enter this code and choose Pair.

data.name: Status_Paired
data.value: Paired. This PC remembers its console and shows what it broadcasts.

data.name: Status_BadCode
data.value: The code is 6 digits. Nothing was saved. Spaces or hyphens between the digits are fine.

data.name: Status_NotSaved
data.value: The code could not be saved: {0}

data.name: Status_PairingUnreadable
data.value: Cannot tell whether this PC is paired: its pairing file could not be read ({0}).

data.name: Status_CodeUnusable
data.value: The saved room code cannot be used. Type the code and save it again.
